Let me also quickly check the Excel file to be thorough.

```python
import pandas as pd

xls_path = '/opt/abb-sdk-repo/examples/datasets/产品生产统计表.xlsx'
xls = pd.ExcelFile(xls_path)
print("Sheets:", xls.sheet_names)
for s in xls.sheet_names:
    sdf = xls.parse(s)
    print(f"  Sheet '{s}': shape={sdf.shape}, cols={list(sdf.columns)}")
```
